raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation Literal `` / `` tokens in prompt text are incorrectly treated as visual boundaries by Nemotron VL's marker-pair padding. Unmatched markers can leave visual rows unpadded; balanced literal pairs can pad text instead, causing an embedding-row mismatch and potentially a CUDA assertion. ## Modifications Pad image/video spans using the processor's recorded offsets rather than searching the prompt for marker pairs. Preserve literal text, visual data offsets, and existing audio padding. ## Accuracy Tests All **6 CPU tests** in the existing `test_nano_nemotron_vl_processor.py` pass. The added regression covers stray start/end markers, balanced literal pairs, and audio-padding preservation. The complete stack is tree-identical to the previous combined version of #44581. Project isort/ruff checks pass. GPU/serving validation has not been rerun for this split. ## Speed Tests and Profiling Not benchmarked; no performance claim or kernel changes. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :hourglass_flowing_sand: [Run #38953760045](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38953760045) Latest PR Test (Extra): :hourglass_flowing_sand: [Run #38953763493](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38953763493) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :hourglass_flowing_sand: [Run #38953760008](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38953760008)

+    def _media_token_ids(self) -> dict[int, str]:
+        """Only placeholders represented by a single token can be spliced."""
+        candidates = {
+            self.mm_tokens.image_token_id: self.IMG_CONTEXT_TOKEN,
+            self.mm_tokens.video_token_id: self.VIDEO_CONTEXT_TOKEN,

+    def _splice_media(
+        self, token_ids: list[int], renders: dict[int, list[str]]
+    ) -> list[int]:
+        """Replace placeholder IDs without re-tokenizing surrounding text."""
+        pending = {
+            tid: deque(rendered) for tid, rendered in renders.items() if rendered
+        }
+        expanded = []
+        for tid in token_ids:
+            queue = pending.get(tid)
+            if queue:
+                expanded.extend(
+                    self.tokenizer.encode(queue.popleft(), add_special_tokens=False)
+                )

+                expanded.append(tid)
+        audio_id = self.mm_tokens.audio_token_id

+            for rendered in pending.pop(audio_id, ()):
+                expanded.extend(
+                    self.tokenizer.encode(rendered, add_special_tokens=False)
+                )
+        if any(pending.values()):
+            raise ValueError("More media items than media placeholders in prompt")
+        return expanded
